name: sample test 1
subject: Ideas to elevate {{company}}'s digital presence
body:
Your Heading Here

I'm Saurav, a freelancer. I really love the work you are doing and the strong impact your business is making in your industry.
While auditing your digital presence, I have gone through your website and social media branding. I found a few places that might need some changes that could uplift your brand higher, just like your premium business deserves.
I provide services in graphic design, web development, UI/UX development, and a lot more. For a summary of my other works, I have recently helped similar forward-thinking brands create clean, engaging visual content that consistently drives user engagement. I am open to working with you on a contract basis to refine these assets.
Please do visit my site or my LinkedIn for further: Portfolio and LinkedIn

Please do let me know if we could connect further.

name: Cold Outreach — SaaS
description: Professional cold outreach for SaaS products
subject: Quick question about {{company}}'s growth strategy
body:
Hi {{name}},

I came across {{company}} and was impressed by what you're building. We help companies like yours automate their outreach and increase conversion rates by 40%.

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call this week to explore if we can help?

Best regards

name: Cold Outreach — Agency
subject: Collaboration idea for {{company}}
body:
Hi {{name}},

I've been following {{company}}'s work and love what you're doing. I specialize in helping agencies scale their client acquisition through automated outreach systems.

I'd love to share some strategies that have worked for similar agencies. Can we connect?

Cheers

name: Cold Outreach — Freelancer
description: Personal outreach from freelancer to potential client
subject: {{name}}, I can help {{company}} with [service]
body:
Hey {{name}}! 👋

I noticed {{company}} is growing fast — congrats! I'm a freelance [role] who specializes in helping companies like yours [value prop].

I recently helped a similar company achieve [specific result]. Would love to chat about doing the same for you.

— [Your Name]

name: Follow-up #1 (Gentle)
description: First gentle follow-up after no response
subject: Re: Quick question about {{company}}
body:
Hi {{name}},

Just wanted to bump my previous email in case it got buried. I know you're busy!

Happy to adjust my approach if the timing isn't right — just let me know.

Best

subject: Thought you'd find this useful, {{name}}
body:
Hi {{name}},

I wanted to share a quick insight that might be relevant to {{company}}:

[Share a relevant tip, stat, or case study]

This is the kind of thing we help companies with every day. Worth a quick chat?

name: Follow-up #3 (Breakup)
subject: Closing the loop — {{company}}
body:
Hi {{name}},

I've reached out a couple of times and haven't heard back, so I'll assume the timing isn't right.

I'll close my file on this, but if things change in the future, my door is always open.

Wishing {{company}} continued success! 🚀

name: Partnership Proposal
subject: Strategic partnership — {{company}} × [Your Company]
body:
Dear {{name}},

I'm reaching out because I see a strong synergy between {{company}} and what we're building.

We serve a similar audience but with complementary offerings. A partnership could help both of us expand our reach significantly.

I've put together a brief one-pager on how this could work. Would you be interested in reviewing it?

Best regards
